scope: Single is one circuit of N genuine binary gates; multiple is 128 identical circuit shapes each with N gates, 128*N total. One fresh process per system/case. Prover time must include commit, recommit, online conversion, gate/copy PIOPs and original native FLOCK PCS opening. Offline fixture/static preprocessing and initial public commitment are excluded. Public recommit is included online. Flock A/B conversion is inside gates_ms; challenge-dependent copy conversion/evaluation/query conversion is inside copy_ms, not a separately measured timer. Raw stage records are retained. One repetition is a descriptive observation, not a statistical speedup estimate.
